title: Triphenylamine-based dicyano fluorophore for the selective detection of hydrazine vapor using cellulose acetate nanofibrous sheet
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37311-37321
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06129B, Paper
Open Access

Boonkasem Choemvarasat, Pipattra Mayurachayakul, Kornkanya Pratumyot, Mongkol Sukwattanasinitt, Nakorn Niamnont
A novel triphenylamine-based dicyano fluorophore (compound 2) was successfully synthesized using a Suzuki cross-coupling reaction, followed by a Knoevenagel condensation catalyzed with baker's yeast.
